summary: Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a notice of redemption for up to $30.5M of its 9.80% First Lien Notes due 2028. The redemption, set for June 10, 2026, will be settled by issuing common stock at par plus accrued interest. The exact shares depend on a five-day VWAP; a floor price limits redemption if VWAP falls below it. This follows a prior $10M redemption, retiring all mandatory principal payments through 2027. The move is part of broader liquidity management ahead of commercial operations in Q4 2026. Watch share count dilution and stock price floor mechanics.
